subject.title: fix: WebChat stop fails for WeChat channel sessions

question: Should maintainers accept the exact persisted-channel-session abort scope, including reply-run registry cancellation, as the canonical WebChat stop contract for hidden channel work?
rationale: The supplied evidence shows the intended WeChat and multi-channel behavior, but deciding which hidden channel operations an administrator-controlled WebChat session may terminate is a cross-channel session and delivery contract decision.

options.title: Accept exact-session scope
options.body: Approve the explicit persisted-channel-session rule after confirming that it is the intended control boundary for all bundled channel reply runs.

options.title: Narrow the abort surface
options.body: Require the branch to stop only chat-controller-backed runs and track reply-run registry cancellation as a separately designed capability.

options.title: Split diagnostic work
options.body: Keep the stop fix focused on WebChat and Gateway abort scope, moving the TUI diagnostic lifecycle changes to a separately reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Accept exact-session scope
recommendation.body: Approve the explicit persisted-channel-session rule after confirming that it is the intended control boundary for all bundled channel reply runs.

likelyOwner.reason: The documented adjacent implementation owns the closest prior WebChat abort lifecycle design and is the strongest available routing signal.
